title: Restructure auth plugin system and upgrade crypto stack to modern JWT/SAML libraries
creator: Maya Chen
description: This ticket consolidates several ad-hoc auth adapters into a single plugin surface and upgrades the underlying crypto/dependency chain used by our authentication path. Goals: (1) Replace multiple in-repo JWT parsing utilities with a vetted, actively maintained JOSE/JWT library with clear parsing/validation semantics; (2) Harden SAML processing by migrating to a safer XML stack and removing fragile transitive xmlsec usage where possible; (3) Upgrade OpenSSL across service images to 3.1.x (or the vetted distro FIPS builds for enterprise queues) and validate TLS handshakes and signing paths; (4) Provide a migration shim so existing tokens and integrations remain compatible during rollout; (5) Add focused unit/e2e tests, fuzzing harness for SAML assertions, and runtime feature flags for canary rollout.
acceptance_criteria: All services use the new auth plugin interface for token verification and SSO assertions
OpenSSL upgraded in CI images and nightly integration pipeline verifies TLS and crypto operations without regressions
Old in-repo JWT parsers removed or wrapped; new JOSE/JWT library passes token interoperability tests with OAuth providers
SAML processing uses the new validation path and rejects all malformed assertions flagged by the fuzz harness
Performance: token verification latency per request remains within 10% of baseline under typical load
Migration: rollout plan with feature flags and canary for 10% of traffic, automatic fallback to previous adapter if errors exceed threshold
steps: Design: define plugin API and backward-compatible adapter shim (owner: Maya)
PoC: integrate recommended JOSE library in auth-service and run token conformance tests (owner: Diego)
SAML: replace xml parser usage and add strict schema/namespace checks; remove direct xmlsec invocations where not required
OpenSSL: update base images, run crypto-benchmark and nightly TLS test matrix
Tests: add unit tests, SAML fuzzing job, and canary e2e tests in staging
Rollback: implement feature-flagged fallback and error thresholds in routing layer
Docs: update internal Confluence SSO onboarding and ops runbook with new troubleshooting steps
